evidence.claim: Cohu describes itself as a supplier of semiconductor test, automation, inspection, metrology, software analytics solutions, and services.

Cohu’s InSight software provides factory monitoring and control for semiconductor test handler and inspection equipment, including real-time visibility, centralized control, remote access, KPI tracking, predictive maintenance, and centralized data management.

Cohu’s DI-Core data intelligence system is described as real-time equipment monitoring and data analytics for Industry 4.0/factory automation, with equipment-performance and inspection-yield use cases.

Camtek provides wafer inspection and metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including advanced packaging, post-dicing, compound wafers, panel-level packaging, and data-analysis capabilities.
Camtek states that it serves leading global IDMs, OSATs, and foundries and that its systems inspect wafers across front-end, mid-end, and beginning assembly processes.

Camtek announced more than $105 million in multi-system orders from a Tier-1 OSAT and a leading HBM manufacturer in June 2026, which supports relevance to advanced packaging/HBM-adjacent manufacturing flows.
Onto Innovation provides semiconductor process solutions across inspection, metrology, lithography, and process-control analytics software.
evidence.source_title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Software & Solutions | Onto Innovation

evidence.claim: Onto Innovation’s annual-report language describes process-control tools and process-control analytical software used by semiconductor manufacturers to provide yield-enhancing information.

memory_update.text: PDFS should be the primary underfollowed direct candidate for semiconductor orchestration software due to Exensio analytics, secureWISE secure equipment connectivity, Cimetrix/equipment integration, and cross-tier fabless/IDM/foundry/OSAT positioning.

COHU is a plausible second-order small-cap candidate because backend test/inspection equipment data, DI-Core, InSight, and PAICe may connect test-cell automation to yield analytics and factory visibility.

CAMT belongs in the discovery lane as an inspection/metrology data-generation and visual-AI adjacency, especially for advanced packaging, OSAT, and HBM-related flows, but the software/orchestration claim remains a hypothesis.

ONTO is useful as a reference pricing/capability anchor for process-control and analytics software embedded in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, but it is less underfollowed and less pure than PDFS.

Next layer should verify software revenue purity, recurring revenue, customer identity, deployment criticality, and whether these tools are production-orchestration systems rather than auxiliary analytics dashboards.

node: Semiconductor manufacturing analytics, secure equipment connectivity, and supply-chain orchestration software
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around the hypothesis that semiconductor complexity is creating a software/data chokepoint across fabless, foundry, IDM, OSAT, test, and equipment tiers. The strongest direct fit is PDF Solutions, whose Exensio, Cimetrix and secureWISE assets map closely to analytics, equipment connectivity, secure collaboration, and orchestration. The underfollowed discovery lane also includes Cohu as a test/inspection equipment vendor with factory-monitoring and data-intelligence software; Camtek as an inspection/metrology supplier where visual AI and data analysis may become a second-order yield-ramp lever; and Onto Innovation as a larger, more followed process-control and analytics reference name. This is not a trade recommendation; all candidates require revenue-segment validation and customer-use-case verification before moving beyond Layer 1.
